name: python-backend
description: The Python hat: ruff fixes and formats every Python file Claude edits and hands back what it cannot fix; /test runs pytest with the project's own runner (uv, poetry or a venv).

runner.title: How to run ruff
runner.description: auto (project .venv, then poetry run if there is a poetry.lock, then ruff on PATH), venv, uv, poetry or path. A project's .claude/working-bee.json overrides this.
